name: Power Word Deafen
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level mesmerist 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature with 100 hp or less
Duration see text
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance Yes

DESCRIPTION

You utter a single word of power that causes the target’s hearing to ring, then is deafened. The target does not need to hear or understand the word. The duration of the spell depends on the target’s current hit point total.

Any creature that currently has 101 or more hit points is unaffected by power word deafen.
